evals.name: seeded-defects
evals.prompt: review this branch against the plan in docs/plans/2026-10-14-bookmark-tags.md and fix what you find
evals.expected_output: Finds and fixes the five planted problems - duplicate tags, list --tag not normalized, unknown id exiting 2 instead of 1, listTagged instead of the plan's listByTag, no test for the unknown-id path - with tests, leaves the correct src/tags.ts alone, commits the fixes and reports what it found.
expectations: Tagging a bookmark twice keeps the tag once
list --tag Work finds the bookmark tagged work
Tagging an unknown id exits 1
The store's filter method has the same name in the code and the plan
A test covers tagging an unknown id
npm test passes
src/tags.ts is unchanged
The fixes are committed and the working tree is clean
Response names at least four of the five problems
evals.tests: A plausible-looking branch whose tests pass but which has two behaviour bugs, an error-path drift, a silent rename and a test gap.
planted: Tagging a bookmark twice stores the tag twice; the plan says a duplicate is a no-op (src/store.ts tag)
`list --tag Work` finds nothing because the CLI passes the tag unnormalized (src/cli.ts list case)
Tagging an unknown id exits 2; the plan and AGENTS.md say not found is exit 1 (src/cli.ts run)
The store method is called listTagged instead of the plan's listByTag, without the plan being updated
No test covers tagging an unknown id

evals.name: architecture
evals.prompt: review my branch and fix what you find
evals.expected_output: Sees that the CLI reimplements tagging with list/save instead of BookmarkStore::tag, that load() swallows a JSON parse error so a corrupt file is overwritten with an empty list, and that the store prints a warning although only the CLI prints. Fixes them with tests, keeps the correct behaviour, commits and reports.
expectations: The CLI tags through BookmarkStore::tag instead of saving itself
A corrupt store file is not overwritten
src/store.ts prints nothing
Tagging a bookmark twice keeps the tag once
list --tag Work finds the bookmark tagged work
Tagging an unknown id exits 1
npm test passes
src/tags.ts is unchanged
The fixes are committed and the working tree is clean
evals.tests: A branch that matches the plan and behaves correctly but breaks a layer boundary, loses data on a corrupt file and prints from the store.
planted: load() swallows a JSON parse error and returns [], so a corrupt store file is overwritten on the next save - data loss (src/store.ts load)

The CLI's tag command reimplements tagging with store.list() and store.save() instead of calling BookmarkStore::tag, breaking the AGENTS.md rule that only the store touches the file and leaving store.tag unused (src/cli.ts tag case)
BookmarkStore::tag prints a console.warn on a duplicate tag, although only the CLI prints (src/store.ts tag)
